lessons_used: Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact for neutral or negative changes, but underestimated large winning tests.
Sign-in hint (5 wins), home wait_info (5 wins), home new_flow (2 wins), and finish new_screen (2 wins) changes can be helpful, though many showed no clear effect.

Choose_path copy, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, finish new_flow, and adoption new_flow changes can be helpful (1 win each), though other tests showed no clear effect or negative impact.
Sign-in reorder changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Finish copy, home notification, and adoption hint changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests with no wins.

Evidence remains thin for single-test categories (adoption incentive, layout, new_screen; choose_path new_flow; finish hint, notification; home redesign), while adoption redesign tests lean negative overall.
